title: AI-Powered Agricultural Contact Center for Farmers
summary: POTRAZ describes pilots in three wards using voice and SMS agricultural advice. Income, loss-reduction, and adoption figures are projections.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: POTRAZ describes pilots in three wards using voice and SMS agricultural advice. Development continues, and income, loss-reduction, and adoption figures are projections.
purpose: Give farmers localized advice through basic phones and local languages.
location: Mashonaland West and Masvingo provinces, Zimbabwe

ratings.reason: Zimbabwean farmers are intended to receive accessible advice and increase income; the 25% income gain and 40% loss reduction are projections.
Agricultural extension organizations are intended to expand service coverage.
Food security and climate resilience are intended, with no attributable public outcome.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 3: AI-Powered Agricultural Contact Center for Farmers

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.
must_hold: Basic-phone access and agricultural information services

headline: Zimbabwe pilots an agricultural voice-advice center
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
